About these 13 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Monday, Friday and Saturday have the most, 3 each. The earliest start is Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride at 6:30 am; the latest is Phoenix Downtempo Ride at 8:00 pm. After work, 6 roll on a weekday evening. Every one is no-drop, so the group waits for everyone. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 1 for women, trans and femme riders, 1 for BIPOC riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 26, 2026.
